history.headline: Still no run since the trail block — the pause has clearly crossed from absorption into an open-ended gap. Steps stay high as the only load. The first structured session is now overdue as data.
watch_items: Watch whether the first run finally appears and returns at a normal easy HR — this is now overdue as the single test of whether the block absorbed cleanly.
Watch whether the gap has now become a genuine unplanned layoff rather than earned recovery — duration is the deciding factor at this point.
Watch whether strength and running re-enter together or whether one leads — both have been dark for the same stretch.
Watch whether the high step floor is masking the absence of any structured stimulus in the athlete's own perception of load.

history.headline: Strength returned before running did — the first structured session in the gap was a lift, not a run. Running remains untaken. The pause is now clearly a deliberate off-block rather than absorption.
watch_items: Watch whether running re-enters now that strength has broken the gap, or whether the lift stands alone as an isolated re-entry.
Watch whether the first easy run returns at a normal easy HR, confirming the trail block absorbed cleanly.
Watch whether any upper-zone or faster stimulus reappears soon — the speed side of the profile has now gone untouched for an extended stretch.
Watch whether training frequency rebuilds into a steady rhythm or remains sporadic after this spike-then-silence pattern.

history.headline: Running is still on hold — the gap since the trail block is now stretching into a genuine off-stretch. Strength touched down once but hasn't built a rhythm. The base underneath remains large and intact.
watch_items: Watch whether running actually re-enters this week, or whether the gap extends further into an unplanned lay-off.
Watch whether strength converts the single recent lift into a repeated cadence rather than another isolated touch.
Watch for the first reappearance of any faster or upper-zone stimulus — the top end has now been dorment for an unusually long stretch.
Watch whether the first easy run comes back at a normal easy HR, confirming the trail block absorbed cleanly.

history.headline: Running still hasn't returned — the gap since the trail block is now a real off-stretch. One recent lift, no rhythm yet. The base underneath remains deep and intact.
watch_items: Watch whether running finally re-enters this week, or whether the off-stretch tips from deliberate into unplanned.
Watch whether the single recent lift becomes a repeated strength cadence rather than another isolated touch.
Watch for the first faster or upper-zone effort — the top end has now been dormant unusually long and needs a fresh reading.
Watch that the first easy run returns at a normal easy HR, confirming the trail block absorbed cleanly.

history.headline: Running has stayed away long enough that the trail block is now fully behind you. One lift last week, but no strength rhythm and no top-end reading in weeks. The base is enormous — the loading side has simply gone quiet.
watch_items: Watch whether the first run back lands at a normal easy HR, confirming the trail block absorbed cleanly rather than left residual fatigue.
Watch whether running re-enters at all this week, or whether the off-stretch continues drifting from deliberate toward unplanned.
Watch for the first upper-zone or faster effort — the top end is now the single biggest blind spot in the data and needs a fresh reading.
